existing_inputs.role: Electron donor that keeps the copper sites of dopamine β-hydroxylase reduced so dopamine can be hydroxylated to noradrenaline
existing_inputs.limitation: Ascorbate is required in the reaction. That does not show that ordinary dietary vitamin C increases human brain noradrenaline or improves attention when vitamin C status is adequate.

existing_inputs.role: The reviewed LNAA pool presents tyrosine through [BRS1 PM2 — LAT1 transport](/docs/biological-targets/brs1/fm1/brs1-fm1-pm2-lat1-competitive-transport-modulation) for synthesis of dopamine, the immediate precursor converted by DBH into noradrenaline.

existing_inputs.role: Folate supplies the methyl group through [BRS2 PM1 — Folate/B12 remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation), replenishing methionine used by [BRS2 PM3 — MAT/SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). existing_inputs.limitation: This requires functional B12-dependent remethylation. existing_inputs.role: Betaine donates methyl groups through [BRS2 PM2 — BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation), predominantly in liver and kidney, replenishing methionine upstream of [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). existing_inputs.limitation: This is peripheral BHMT supply, not neuronal BHMT activity or measured delivery into neural SAM. Dietary methionine and folate remethylation provide alternatives. existing_inputs.role: Choline can be oxidised to betaine for [BRS2 PM2 — BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation), predominantly in liver and kidney, replenishing methionine upstream of [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis). existing_inputs.role: Phenylalanine is hydroxylated to tyrosine in peripheral tissues, replenishing the circulating tyrosine available to [LAT1 transport](/docs/biological-targets/brs1/fm1/brs1-fm1-pm2-lat1-competitive-transport-modulation) upstream of noradrenaline synthesis.

pms.title: Acetylcholine Synthesis Support
pms.mission: Maintain the capacity to form acetylcholine so cholinergic signalling for attention, working memory, and learning stays supplied.

existing_inputs.role: Direct substrate combined with acetyl-CoA by choline acetyltransferase to form acetylcholine
existing_inputs.limitation: Choline is required and diet supplies it, but additional intake has not been shown here to raise acetylcholine synthesis in the human brain or improve attention.

existing_inputs.role: Dietary choline-containing phospholipid that is digested and remodelled, producing circulating choline as one route to the direct choline substrate
existing_inputs.limitation: Human tracer evidence establishes phosphatidylcholine as a choline-provision route; it does not show delivery to cholinergic terminals or increased brain acetylcholine synthesis.

existing_inputs.limitation: Acetyl-CoA is a cellular reaction substrate, not a dietary acetyl-CoA recommendation; ordinary dietary control of its availability in human cholinergic neurons is not established.

existing_inputs.role: Nutritional precursor of coenzyme A, from which cells form the acetyl-CoA required for acetylcholine synthesis
existing_inputs.limitation: Chronic ethanol-associated pantothenate depletion and rescue affected acetylcholine synthesis in rats; this does not establish that extra B5 raises brain acetylcholine in adequately nourished humans.

existing_inputs.role: Folate-dependent methyl metabolism helps maintain the brain choline resource available for acetylcholine formation; folate deprivation lowered choline and acetylcholine in studied mouse models, with SAM rescue supporting this upstream resource relationship.
existing_inputs.limitation: Animal evidence is conditional on age, brain region and experimental context. existing_inputs.limitation: Only the choline-to-betaine methyl-supply route is admitted here, not choline membrane or neurotransmitter roles. pms.title: Nrf2-Mediated Cellular Defence Regulation
pms.mission: Regulate the expression of cellular defence genes in response to oxidative and electrophilic stress.

existing_inputs.role: Modulates KEAP1-mediated control of Nrf2, promoting antioxidant-response gene transcription. Human dietary exposure increased Nrf2-associated phase II enzyme RNA in nasal lavage cells.
